{{Quote|You've met Thrawn. Any true warrior would have given up whatever was necessary for the chance to serve under him.|Voss Parck to Mara Jade|<ref name="votf">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Thrawn's confederation''', sometimes referred as '''Thrawn's Empire''', was a military force under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], a cunning and ruthless [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who returned to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and led a [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. 

Thrawn had the support of [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]] and the remnants of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] on [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]], who sanctioned Thrawn to rebuild the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and the subsequent breakdown of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. Thrawn had also allied with the various [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] with the aim of taking back the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Members==
{{Quote|The New Order has never fallen. Only the Emperor. &hellip; The Emperor may be dead, but the Empire lives on!|Ardus Kaine|<ref name="tpa">{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment}}</ref>}}
*Scattered Imperial planets, including [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]], [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]], [[Linuri]], [[Chasin]], [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]], [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]], [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], and [[Columex/Legends|Columex]]

*[[Pentastar Alignment]]: ruled by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]]
*[[Ciutric Hegemony]]: ruled by [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]]
*[[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]: ruled by [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]]
*[[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]]: ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tol Getelles|Getelles]]
*[[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]: formerly ruled by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]], as he was stranded in the [[Fardon system]] with his heavily damaged [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] at the time.
*[[Noghri Overclan]]: a planetary wide confederation of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]], later defected to the New Republic.
*Thrawn also controlled at least three shipyards, these included: [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]] [[Yaga Minor shipyards/Legends|shipyards]], [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]] [[Ord Trasi shipyards|shipyards]], and [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]] [[Bilbringi shipyards|shipyards]].

==History==
===Formation===
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], four years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] finally returned from the Unknown Regions to the Empire. Thrawn formed his personal [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|armada]] of six [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] and gathered other Imperial warships; with this fleet, he launched a series of successful raids against pirate nests and the border regions of the New Republic.

[[File:Thrawn-SOC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and his [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]].]]

By demonstrating his tactical and strategic genius, he impressed the Empire's remaining [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and earned the support of many [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] in addition to the powerful [[D'Asta family]]. He was quickly given control of all Imperial armed forces by the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] and appointed [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the Empire.

Fearing coups, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] and [[Prince-Admiral/Legends|Prince-Admiral]] [[Delak Krennel]] agreed to give Thrawn command of a temporary military confederation. To keep this unity, Thrawn never acknowledged that his forces as a single political entity and let all the Imperial leaders and warlords rule their territory in their own way.

===Thrawn campaign===
{{Main|Thrawn campaign}}

===Fragmentation===
[[File:ThrawnDeath-TLC6.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Thrawn's [[Death/Legends|death]].]]

After Grand Admiral Thrawn's [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|death]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the Imperial leaders dispersed and returned to their personal holdings. The Imperial Ruling Council retook control of the Empire, more extended than ever.

Despite this failure, many [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] kept up morale, believing the Empire could emerge reunited and victorious despite Thrawn's demise. This would happen [[10 ABY/Legends|next year]] with the [[Operation Shadow Hand|return]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and later in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] with the [[Imperial Reunification]].

==Military==
During his campaign, Thrawn exclusively used the remnant forces of the Empire, while the other factions of the confederation supported the Grand Admiral almost only financially.

===Naval===
{{Main|Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)}}
[[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]],<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]], [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-medium class cruisers]], [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]], [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]]s<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> and [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> served as primary [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the fleet.

After the [[Battle for the Katana fleet|Battle for the]] [[Katana fleet|Katana Fleet]], 179 automated [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnought''-class heavy cruisers]] were added to the fleet.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

At least four [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun|Golan II Space Defense Platforms]] were used by the fleet, with more potentially in their possession. Thrawn did at least have another one that was equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking technology]].<ref name="Last Command" />

[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE L/N starfighters]],<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]],<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]]<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> were the primary [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used by the fleet. [[Scimitar assault bomber]]s would later be used in the fleet.<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

[[F7 "Landing Brick" Drop-Ship]]s<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> would be used notably, alongside [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] and [[Assault shuttle/Legends|Assault Shuttles]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

[[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Naval troopers]] would be utilized as well, guarding and maintaining military bases in addition to [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />

The [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]], [[Black Wing Squadron]], and [[Scimitar assault wing]] served within the armada, with the 181st Wing and Black Wing serving at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilibringi]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare2">''[[Battle of Endor/Legends|<nowiki/>]][[Death/Legends|The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

===Army===
With Thrawn being [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], Thrawn was able to gather up a large armed force of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]], [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], and [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transports]]<ref name="Dark Force Rising" /> served as primary [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] for the fleet. [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariots]], [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortresses]], and [[Swift Assault 5|Swift Assaults 5]], [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]]s, [[S-1 FireHawke Heavy Repulsortank]]s, [[Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank/Legends|''Imperial''-class 1-H Repulsortanks]], [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]s, [[Repulsor scout|Repulsor Scouts]], [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]], and [[Stormtrooper transport (Trogan)|armored transport carriers]] were also used.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

[[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army Troopers]] would be used to guard [[Planet/Legends|planets]] underneath Thrawn's control.<ref name="Last Command" />

With Thrawn commanding the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], He was able to command the remnants of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during his campaign.

[[Storm commando/Legends|Storm Commandos]], alongside [[Noghri Death Commando]]s were used on specialized missions.<ref name="The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]], [[Land assault trooper|Imperial Assault Troopers]], and [[Scout trooper/Legends|Biker Scouts]] were used for conquests, and guarding planets. During the [[Battle of Sluis Van|attack]] on [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] [[Sluis Van Shipyards|Shipyards]], [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Zero-G Assault Stormtroopers]] were used to board the [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> [[Radiation zone assault trooper|Imperial Radiation Troopers]] were used to attack the radioactive surface of [[Qat Chrystac]]. [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|Sandtroopers]] were deployed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to retrieve a painting.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref>

===Intelligence===
Although [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] was disbanded after the supposed death of [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]], the agency's assets remained, and were used heavily by Thrawn.<ref name="Last Command" />

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Molo Himron]] was handpicked by Thrawn to travel to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with his squad of [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commandos]] to infiltrate the repurposed Imperial Palace and [[Raid on Coruscant (Thrawn Crisis)|capture]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] [[Solo twins|twins]], with a secondary objective to neutralize [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who had [[Treason/Legends|defected]] to the New Republic.<ref name="Last Command" />

Before Thrawn began striking at New Republic bases, he learned of [[Delta Source]], a series of audio intelligence recording devices installed inside of the the trees within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> These would be used extensively to spy on Republic senators, military officials, and notable figures, as well as to gather information, until their discovery and removal in 9 ABY.

===Weapons===
After discovering [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], Thrawn made use of experimental [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking technology]], as well as approximately 20,000 [[spaarti cloning cylinder]]s. The latter provided the vast majority of the Grand Admiral's manpower late into his campaign, since his fleet was short on crew and [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] before their discovery.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

The cloaking devices at Thrawn's disposal were used heavily; at least several [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were cloaked, and Thrawn would use these devices on dozens of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in order to use them as a siege weapon for his [[Siege of Coruscant|retaking of]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by placing them into orbit.<ref name="Last Command" />

During the Thrawn Crisis, his fleet utilized several [[Siege platform/Legends|siege platforms]] stationed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qat Chrystac]]. It deployed [[Radiation zone assault trooper|Imperial Radiation Troopers]] onto the planet's surface in order to destroy the secret New Republic base.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

[[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]] were used within the fleet.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />

During the [[Battle of Woostri]], Thrawn used [[Attack cruiser/Legends|attack cruisers]] with cloaking devices to perform a surprise attack on the planet.<ref name="Last Command" />

At the [[Shipyard/Legends|Imperial shipyards]] within the Bilbringi [[Bilbringi system/Legends|system]], a [[crystal gravfield trap]] was kept there by Thrawn. [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|Shield barriers]] were also stationed there for defense purposes.<ref name="Last Command" />

[[Ysalamiri/Legends|Ysalamir]] was used heavily by Thrawn's forces to combat [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]].<ref name="Last Command" />

During [[Raid on Nomad City]], 51 [[Plasma-Jet Mole Miner]]s were stolen and eventually used to hijack [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] ships at the [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] [[Shipyard/Legends|Shipyards]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />

==Astrography==
[[File:ThrawnsCampaigns-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Thrawn's confederation in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].]]

At the end of his campaign, Grand Admiral Thrawn controlled more than a third of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], an equivalent territory to that of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After his death over Bilbringi and his confederation's subsequent collapse.

*[[Imperial Space]] : this included all Thrawn's conquests in his [[Thrawn campaign|final campaign]].
*Isolated Imperial planets before Thrawn's return, including [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]], [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]], [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]], [[Chasin]], [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]], [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]], [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], and [[Columex/Legends|Columex]]
*[[Pentastar Alignment]] territory
*[[Ciutric Hegemony]] territory
*[[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]
*[[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]]
*[[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]]
